performance_case.causal_mechanism: One common systemd writable mount-namespace parent lets the frozen same-filesystem Java directory rename remain atomic while existing Unix DAC and sticky-directory ownership continue to isolate private staging from published evidence.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task can prove only a five-file offline unit, verifier, test and documentation correction. It cannot prove live systemd namespace behavior, recover R1, create a future generation, complete 14 days, establish prediction, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate strategy drawdown effect is zero. Avoiding deterministic evidence loss can shorten time to a later path-risk decision, but any drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a separately preregistered matched-capital forward experiment passes.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Leaving the two child paths as separate systemd writable mounts deterministically loses each completed day at atomic publication; broadening protocol semantics or repairing partial R1 bytes would instead contaminate forward evidence. The smallest useful action is a namespace-only correction followed by a new untouched generation.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL is unchanged. The infrastructure value is preventing another deterministic publication failure so one future 14-day microstructure screen can produce or reject a strategy mechanism without another full-window delay.
